name: Yaqazah
author: Ebrahim Saad
description: An Islamic companion for Omarchy that breaks the digital trance of long computer sessions with prayer countdowns, a daily timetable, athkar, and mindful spiritual reminders.

barWidget.description: Next prayer countdown, daily timetable, and mindful Islamic reminders directly on your desktop.

schema.label: Bar widget look
schema.description: Choose between countdown (1h 30m), scheduled time (15:30), or smart (time until less than 1 hour left, then countdown).

schema.label: Bar widget separator
schema.description: Separator between prayer name and timer in the bar (dot, dash, pipe, colon, parens, space, or custom).

schema.label: Time system
schema.description: Clock format for prayer times: 24-hour (15:30) or 12-hour (3:30 PM).

schema.label: Location
schema.description: Auto detects your city from your public IP. Manual uses the city and country below.

schema.label: Manual city
schema.description: Used when Location is set to Manual.

schema.label: Manual country
schema.description: Country name or two-letter code for the manual city.

schema.label: Calculation method
schema.description: Auto selects a commonly used method for the detected country.

schema.label: Prayer notifications
schema.description: Show a desktop notification when each prayer begins.
